objective: Evaluate the effectiveness of the FRP sleeve in reducing tibial tray fracture rate under cyclic loading conditions
dependent_variables: tibial tray fracture rate under cyclic loading
controls: mechanical bonding between FRP sleeve and tibial tray
cyclic loading conditions without FRP sleeve
baseline: Control group (tibial tray without FRP sleeve)
procedure: Prepare tibial trays with and without FRP sleeves
Apply cyclic loading conditions to the tibial trays
Monitor and record the tibial tray fracture rate under cyclic loading
Maintain temperature and relative humidity within the specified ranges
expected_result: A 40% decrease in tibial tray fracture rate under cyclic loading compared to the control group
falsification_condition: If the tibial tray fracture rate under cyclic loading is not reduced by at least 35% compared to the control group, or if the fracture rate is increased by more than 10% compared to the control group
sample_requirements: A minimum of 30 tibial trays with FRP sleeves and 30 tibial trays without FRP sleeves
safety_constraints: Ensure that the cyclic loading conditions do not cause damage to the tibial trays or the FRP sleeves
information_gain: The effectiveness of the FRP sleeve in reducing tibial tray fracture rate under cyclic loading conditions, and the potential for improving the design of orthopedic implants
